body:
The following file causes ty to spend over a minute checking it and then panic:

```python
@0
class C[**P]:
    pass

while -():
    (P := C[P])
```

```console
ty check repro.py --python-version 3.12 --python-platform linux
```

On Ruff revision `0fa37a3c33`, the check panics in `infer_definition_types` after about 71 seconds. The decorator and loop condition are invalid, but ty should report diagnostics and finish checking the file. The original source was generated by `pysource-codegen` 0.7.1 using fuzzer seed `19213` and then minimized.

The default diagnostic is shown below with local paths shortened:

<details>
<summary>Full ty output for seed 19213</summary>

```text
error[panic]: Panicked at <cargo registry>/salsa-0.28.5/src/function/execute.rs:751:9 when checking `repro.py`: `infer_definition_types(Id(402)): execute: too many cycle iterations`
info: This indicates a bug in ty.
info: If you could open an issue at https://github.com/astral-sh/ty/issues/new?title=%5Bpanic%5D, we'd be very appreciative!
info: Platform: macos aarch64
info: Version: ruff/0.16.9+32 (0fa37a3c3 2026-09-28)
info: Args: ["ty", "check", "repro.py", "--python-version", "3.12", "--python-platform", "linux"]
info: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to show the full backtrace information
info: query stacktrace:
   0: infer_definition_types(Id(402))
             at crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/infer.rs:234
   1: infer_definition_types(Id(403))

   2: infer_scope_types_impl(Id(380))
             at crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/infer.rs:520

             at crates/ty_project/src/lib.rs:959

Found 1 diagnostic

WARN A fatal error occurred while checking some files. Not all project files were analyzed. See the diagnostics list above for details.
```

</details>

The behavior changes at Ruff commit [97060ba557](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/commit/97060ba557e31ff2f3d75d32dc93ef48d0c7ffa2), introduced by [#28067](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/28067). The immediately preceding commit completes this example with ordinary diagnostics; the introducing commit did not complete within 20 seconds. The original generated file also completes at the parent and exceeds 20 seconds at the introducing commit under Python 3.10 mode.

There may be a connection to the loop-related panics in [#4427](https://github.com/astral-sh/ty/issues/4427) and [#4429](https://github.com/astral-sh/ty/issues/4429), but their fix, [ruff#28212](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/28212), is present in ty 0.0.77 and this example still does not complete within 20 seconds on that release. Whether the underlying causes overlap is unverified.

## Additional examples

The following examples were minimized from source generated by `pysource-codegen` 0.7.1. Both examples and their original generated files finish with ordinary diagnostics at the parent of Ruff commit [97060ba557](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/commit/97060ba557e31ff2f3d75d32dc93ef48d0c7ffa2), while the introducing commit does not finish checking them within 20 seconds. Replacing the outer `@0` decorator with an undefined name (`@missing`) in any of the three minimized examples also completes at the parent but does not finish within 12 seconds at the introducing commit, using Python 3.12 mode. The cause of the cycles has not been established, so it is unclear whether the examples have the same underlying cause.

### Fuzzer seed 16371

```python
(name_4 := (lambda: name_1))

@0
@name_4
class name_3:
    pass
(name_1 := (lambda: name_3))
```

```console
ty check repro-16371.py --python-version 3.10 --python-platform linux
```

On Ruff revision `0fa37a3c33`, this example panics in `place_by_id` after about 25 seconds. The default diagnostic follows, with local paths shortened:

### Fuzzer seed 15216

```python
@0
@lambda: {name_5 for name_4 in name_3}
class name_4:
    pass
match 0:
    case name_3.name_2:
        raise

@{**(lambda: name_5)}
async def name_5():
    pass
(name_5 := name_4)
```

```console
ty check repro-15216.py --python-version 3.10 --python-platform linux
```

On Ruff revision `0fa37a3c33`, this check did not finish within 100 seconds and produced no output. No panic was observed during that run.
title: Cycle-iteration panic when specializing a decorated generic class in a loop
